message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/file && grep -n "magic_buffer\|file_buffer" src/magic.c src/funcs.c | head -20

message.content:
OK, so the fuzzer loads the magic database once and then calls `magic_buffer` on the input data. The input data is the file content to identify. So the vulnerability must be in the code that processes the input data, not in the magic file parsing.
